induction h using AddConGen.Rel.induction on a b
case refl => exact hr a b h
case add c d e f hc hd he hf =>
  have h1 : AddConGen.Rel r c e := hc
  have h2 : AddConGen.Rel r d f := hd
  have h3 : AddConGen.Rel r (star c) (star e) := lg_target hr h1
  have h4 : AddConGen.Rel r (star d) (star f) := lg_target hr h2
  exact AddConGen.Rel.add h3 h4
